- Tuesday: 13:00-14:00

workspace.text:

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad, I've carefully rechecked Priya and Marcus's calendars against the slots you provided where Elena and David are both free. Unfortunately, there is NO overlap between the two sets:

Elena+David free slots vs Priya+Marcus availability:
- Monday 11:00-12:00: Priya is busy 11:00-12:00 (Travel, Contract review, Recruiting call)
- Tuesday 9:00-10:00: Priya is busy 9:00-10:00 (Board prep, Partner lunch)
- Wednesday 13:00-14:00: Priya is busy 13:00-14:00 (Client call, Client dinner prep)
- Thursday 09:30-10:00: Priya is busy 09:30-10:00
- Thursday 14:30-15:30: Marcus is busy 14:30-15:00 (Dentist), Priya is busy 15:00-15:30
- Friday 15:00-16:00: Priya is busy 15:00-16:00 (Hiring panel, Contract review)

I also verified the only slots where Priya+Marcus are both free:
- Tuesday 13:00-14:00 (but Elena+David are not free then)
- Thursday 10:00-10:30 (but Elena+David are not free then)

There is no 30-minute slot next week where all four partners are free. We should report this as infeasible.

infeasible.reason: After checking all four partners' calendars, there is no 30-minute time slot next week (Nov 16-20) where all four partners (Priya Raman, Marcus Hale, Elena Soto, and David Okafor) are simultaneously free. The availability windows for Priya+Marcus (Tuesday 13:00-14:00, Thursday 10:00-10:30) do not overlap with the availability windows for Elena+David (Monday 11:00-12:00, Tuesday 9:00-10:00, Wednesday 13:00-14:00, Thursday 09:30-10:00 or 14:30-15:30, Friday 15:00-16:00).
